item.title: Pothole on the road sunk Marlow Road no 94, 15th August
item.description:
I am reporting road surface defects and potholes at this location Sheringham Road/Marlow Road. The recent prolonged hot weather has dried out the local soil, which is magnifying ground vibrations. As a result, each time when bus 356 passes by into these potholes, it causes a noticeable vibration to travel directly into my first-floor flat.Please arrange an inspection to repair these potholes and restore a smooth road surface to resolve the traffic vibration issue. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sheringham Road, Anerley, Greater London
